title: Correct acceleration calculation
description: Essential: The response must give the correct acceleration value of 6 m/s².

title: Correct total distance
description: Essential: The response must give the correct total distance value of 105.6 m.

title: Force balance and friction
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve the applied force and calculate the normal force including the vertical component, then apply F_net = ma.

title: Two-phase kinematics
description: Important: The solution must treat the motion in two distinct phases: constant acceleration under the force, then deceleration under friction only.

title: Post-force deceleration
description: Important: After force removal, the solution must correctly compute the new (deceleration) acceleration using kinetic friction on a level surface.

title: Velocity and distance continuity
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the final velocity from phase 1 as the initial velocity for phase 2.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculated quantities should be expressed with correct SI units (m, s, m/s²).

title: Sign error in normal force
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculating the normal force (e.g., forgetting that the vertical component of F reduces it).

title: Ignoring second phase
description: Pitfall: Stopping after calculating the distance in the first 4 seconds, or treating the motion as stopping instantly when F is removed.
